gate_type: CONTRACT-LAYER gate (Issue #91): materialize the frozen X0 SH-WTP whole-plant design into repo-native, machine-readable process/topology/fidelity/control contracts plus the authoritative X2 admission manifest. No whole-plant runtime, no PI/PID dynamics, no rich UI.
sa_decision_ref: Issue #91 (SA Task Contract, authoritative); required base c9d64a5 (X0 CLOSED, verdict SHW_WHOLE_PLANT_DESIGN_FROZEN)
architecture_authority_ref: Issue #89 / X0 freeze (reports/VF-SHW-X0.md, evidence/VF-SHW-X0/**) + Issue #78 (R0 frozen) + frozen chain 'SH-WTP Workspace -> ONE RuntimeSession -> RunLifecycleService -> ShwtpExecutionBridge -> whole-plant composition/coordinator -> Area/Process participants -> Key Asset models/controllers -> runtime truth -> projections/UI'
objective: Create the X1 contract layer: (1) a deterministic whole-plant operational process graph contract covering RAW-WATER/T100, LINE1 T101..T108, DIST-P108, the CHEMICAL and SLUDGE side streams, WASH-T110 recovery, the LINE2 shallow aggregate path and the ELECTRICAL/AUTOMATION reference-only areas, with every node/edge classified pim_known vs vf_scenario_assumption vs reference_only and carrying explicit provenance; (2) complete scope/fidelity process contracts for every X2-runtime-eligible scope; (3) complete control contracts materializing C0/C1/C2 with the full field set and an implementation_gate per control; (4) frozen Deep Scope A (LINE1 downstream T106/T107/T108-centred, T107 explicitly VF-assumed) and Deep Scope B (RAW WATER + T100) Key Asset interface boundaries; (5) the authoritative X2 admission manifest that is the authorization boundary for the next gate. No runtime, session or controller may be constructed.
explicit_non_objectives: No whole-plant runtime execution and no runnable whole-plant model
No PI/PID dynamic implementation (contracts only; C2 loops deferred to X3/X4)
No RuntimeSession / RunLifecycleService redesign and no second run authority
No modification of existing SH-WTP runtime behaviour (new contract module only)
No PIM write and no PIM semantic change
forbidden_paths_note: tests/ is intentionally NOT listed as a whole-directory forbidden entry: the required deliverable tests/test_vnext_x1_whole_plant_contracts.py is a NEW test module, so test protection is enforced at file granularity by allowed_paths (exactly one test file is allowed; every other changed test path fails the allowlist). This mirrors the accepted VF-vNEXT-R5 contract convention. No pre-existing test module is permitted to change.
required_smoke_checks: Canonical baseline green at the pushed head (new x1_whole_plant_contracts group included)
Full suite green at the pushed head
forbidden_actions: Constructing any runtime, session, bridge, engine or controller
Adding or changing a PIM semantic identity
Activating a C2 loop in X2
Expanding beyond the X2 admission manifest
stop_conditions: A required process/node/relationship cannot be represented without adding/changing PIM semantics
The X0 deep-scope boundaries prove internally inconsistent
A control contract requires choosing between materially different product behaviours not frozen in X0
X2 admission cannot be defined without implementing runtime to discover the contract
The canonical SH-WTP architecture would have to change

acceptance_criteria.description: Whole-plant process graph contract is deterministic and schema-valid, covering the frozen path and side streams with per-edge categories pim_known / vf_scenario_assumption / reference_only
Every PIM canonical id referenced already exists in the accepted PIM-derived inventory/graph; no new canonical id invented; VF-local ids use the vf-shw- namespace
Every assumed edge carries explicit VF assumption provenance (source_kind/status/reversible/assumption_id) and no edge is simultaneously PIM-known and VF-assumed

Every X2-admitted executable scope has a complete process/fidelity contract (inputs, outputs, state, parameters+units, constraints, conservation, update family, init/reset, invalid state, PIM ceiling, proposed VF fidelity, site_truth=false)
Every X2 C1 control has a complete control contract and every C2 loop is explicitly deferred to X3/X4 and inactive in X2
X2 admission manifest is complete (executable scopes, reference/container-only, C1 active, C2 deferred, assumed edges used, invariants) and internally consistent with the other contracts
Zero runtime/session/controller/engine construction added by the contract layer
R1-R5/UX01/X0 baseline and full suite remain green
